description: SRS scheduling is 100% server-side. Client posts SrsRequest(personId, studiableContainerId, studiableContainerType, personTimezone, personTestDate, clientLatestAnswers) to POST https://api.quizlet.com/3.11/srs/status with body {"srs": {...}}. Whole-tree search (23,433 Java files) returns zero hits for easiness/leitner/supermemo/sm-2/fsrs/nextDue/intervalDays: no scheduling math exists on the client.
title: SRS client/server contract (server-side scheduling)

description: Server returns SDUI RemoteSrsStepsResponse(heading, progressBar, progressFraction, steps, events{onBegin,onEnter,onExit}); after each step the client fires RemoteGetNextSrsStepsClientAction(type, props{url, queryParams}, events{onSuccess,onFailure}) to fetch the next steps from a server-provided URL. Per-step client<->server loop, no prefetch.
title: Server-driven SRS steps loop (SDUI)

description: ORMLite table 'userStudyable' (DBUserStudyable) stores the server-computed dueTimestampSec per (personId, studyableId, studyableType) plus lastStudiedTimestamp, startTimestampSec, isActive, isDismissed, notificationStatus. Client stores the due time, never computes it: 'server computes, client stores and reminds' pattern.
title: Due-timestamp local store (DBUserStudyable)

description: Authoritative 12-mode registry as a HashSet of URL fragments: blast, blocks, cards, classic-cards, flashcards, learn, match, microscatter, scatter, test, write, spaced-repetition. Internal StudyMode enum x4 has 26 entries with stable numeric ids (WRITE=1 ... SPACED_REPETITION=26), used by analytics and APIs.
title: Study-mode registry (12 URL fragments + x4 enum)

description: Readable KMP shared library: StudiableQuestion subtypes (MultipleChoice, TrueFalse, FillInTheBlank+Segment, RevealSelfAssessment, MixedOptionMatching); grading package (MatchingGameResponse, MultipleChoiceResponse, TrueFalseResponse, RevealSelfAssessmentResponse, StudiableQuestionResponse/Feedback, StudiableTestResults); progress (StudiableStep, StudiableCheckpoint, StudiableRoundProgress/TaskProgress/TotalProgress, StudiableWriteMasteryBuckets).

description: LearnRoundSummaryData(studyableModelData, studySessionId, roundResults, progressState, currentTaskProgress, numFocusedLearnTerms); StudiableCheckpoint(AssistantCheckpointProgressState, isComplete, steps, meteringData). Round -> tasks -> mastery-checkpoint session model.

description: AchievementBadgesData holds 7 badge groups: studyData, dailyStreakData, weeklyStreakData, setsStudiedData, roundsStudiedData, explanationsStudiedData, studyGuidesCreated. Enum f: DAY, WEEK, DAILY_STREAKS, WEEKLY_STREAKS, SETS_STUDIED, ROUNDS_STUDIED, EXPLANATIONS_STUDIED, STUDY_GUIDES_CREATED, NONE. UI: AchievementsActivity, AchievementEarnedView, achievements/notification/. Daily and weekly streaks are separate tracks.

description: oldlearn/usecase/streaks/a.java: streak valid iff b0.b() && streakCount > 1 && flag; milestone celebration when (x - 15) % 10 == 0 for type a0.TWO. Heavily obfuscated; design-level only (celebrate every 10).
title: Learn streak predicates (old engine)

description: features/match/studyengine/ (a-g.java, obfuscated): engine e builds MatchingGameResponse(i, i2) and submits to manager b via coroutine; packages highscore/ (HighScoresState), managers/, logging/, settings/, audio/. Design = engine + manager + grading + highscore; logic not recoverable.
title: Match game engine design

description: StudyModeEventLogger.Factory builds a per-mode logger bound to an x4 StudyMode; SrsEventLogger wraps it for x4.SPACED_REPETITION and logs SrsEventLog via eventLogger.d(). Events observed: srs_setup_modal_impression (modalType=choose_method, screen=flashcards), settings open/close with studyableId. Enums: SrsModalType, SrsScreen, SrsSortingType, SrsErrorType, Actions (R8-gutted names).
title: Per-study-mode event-logging architecture

description: DBOfflineEntity table + offline/managers/{a,g}.java + offline/data/a.java: full sets are downloaded as offline entities and synced. Clean data layer: data/repository/ + data/interactor/ + data/model/.
title: Offline-first entity sync

New KMP client shared/quizletapi/ (one package per resource: srs, grading, studyset, folders, eligibility, studynotes, studiableMetadata, folderstudymaterials) with kotlinx.serialization; legacy Retrofit client in api/. 134 Java files across api/ + shared/quizletapi/. Analytics via Snowplow https://com-quizlet-prod1.collector.snplow.net.
title: Network layer (api.quizlet.com + KMP client)

description: com.quizlet.quizletandroid.firebase.services.QuizletFirebaseMessagingService is exported and handles com.google.firebase.MESSAGING_EVENT (manifest-verified; class merged by R8, not in jadx). DBUserStudyable.notificationStatus (0/1) + dueTimestampSec = daily due-reminder use case. POST_NOTIFICATIONS declared.
